search_audit.query: Open 武 — historical form and meaning
search_audit.outcome: Oracle 武 combines the weapon 戈 and foot-shaped 止, interpreted as an armed force advancing. Bronze uses include military affairs and martial strength. The traditional “stop weapons” interpretation expresses an ethical ideal, but need not be the original construction because early 止 often indicates walking.
